description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing 'Task' entities within a Room database in an Android application. It includes queries for observing tasks, inserting, updating, deleting specific tasks, and marking tasks as completed.

classes.name: TaskDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object (DAO) interface for performing database operations related to 'Task' entities in a Room database.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the list of all tasks, ordered by completion status and last update time.

methods.name: observeById
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the task with the specified id, if it exists.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a task into the database, replacing any existing task with the same primary key, and returns the new task id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified task from the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes the task with the specified id from the database.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Updates the completion status and last updated timestamp for the task with the given id.
